channel.title: InvestPR Media Monitoring
channel.description: Aerostar's $173 million LMM airport parking garage, AES's proposed Guayama plant extension with about $820 million in planned investment, and Hilton's San Juan dual-brand opening lead the period's investment news. Outside operators also expanded in Puerto Rico: Aeroméxico/Delta announced a Mexico City–San Juan route, Pep Boys is remodeling its service centers, Fazoli's opened a second restaurant, and Aman's Cabo Rojo resort advanced. The main risks are energy and corporate stress: New Fortress Energy's LNG supply dispute is raising diesel costs, LUMA faces government pressure over unspent federal funds, and Encanto Restaurants' Chapter 11 left roughly 2,600 workers without jobs. On the climate side, the Senate moved to keep Opportunity Zone incentives and the House advanced the permitting reform, while new bills target electricity costs.
